subject: Request: Conditional tranche deferral + credit for BlueHarbor pilot
messages:
From: Jill Summers <jill@blueharbor.com>

Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@blueharbor.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Temporary invoicing and onboarding credit for pilot

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looked great. We have buy-in for a 6-month pilot but finance needs a special invoicing setup to align with our internal fiscal calendar. Two asks from our side: 

1) Can Redwood invoice on a quarterly split for the pilot (three invoices over six months) instead of monthly?
2) As this is a pilot with a late Q4 start, can you offer a one-time onboarding credit against the first invoice (we're targeting a 10% credit)?

We understand these are non-standard requests. If needed we can sign a short amendment or provide PO paperwork.

Attaching a summary of our purchase request.

Thanks,
Jill
Jill Summers
Head of Data Platform
BlueHarbor Analytics
Attachments: BlueHarbor_request_summary.pdf
From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-06T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Temporary invoicing and onboarding credit for pilot

Forwarding BlueHarbor's request — they want (a) quarterly invoicing split for a 6-month pilot (3 invoices) and (b) a one-time 10% onboarding credit if we sign quickly.

Sales context: ACV for pilot ~ $180k (estimate), expansion potential into multiple accounts. They will sign if finance is flexible on cadence + small credit.

@karthik_iyer — can deal desk/finance support a quarterly split here and what approvals are needed for a one-time 10% credit?
@marissa_cole / @jonas_weber — looping you for exec/finance sign-off if this needs to go to leadership.

I attached the vendor summary (they included their PO template).

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-07T08:19:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Temporary invoicing and onboarding credit for pilot

Thanks for the context Aisha. Quick thoughts: 

- Quarterly split for a 6-month pilot (3 invoices) is operationally OK — we can map milestone schedule to invoice dates, but need acceptance criteria documented in SOW/Amendment.
- One-time credit: 10% of $180k = $18k — this is material but not unprecedented for strategic pilots. Finance policy: credits up to 7.5% can be approved by Deal Desk; anything above requires finance / revenue leadership signoff.

Can you confirm exact pilot ACV and proposed invoice dates? If we keep the credit conditional on contract signed by 12/31 and a 30-day payment SLA after invoice, I can prepare a condensed approval packet for Marissa/Jonas.

I'll draft the approval summary and include revenue impact and recovery plan.

-Karthik
Head of Deal Desk (Sales Ops), Redwood Inference
From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Exec approval request: BlueHarbor one-time 10% onboarding credit + quarterly invoicing

Marissa / Jonas — per Karthik, attaching the brief approval packet. Executive ask: approve one-time 10% onboarding credit tied to a 6-month pilot (est. pilot ACV $180,000) and permit quarterly invoicing (3 invoices over 6 months) with invoice schedule: 2027-01-15, 2027-04-15, 2027-07-15. Conditions proposed:

- Credit only applied to invoice #1 and only if contract fully executed by 2026-12-31.
- 30-day payment terms from invoice date (Net-30) for pilot invoices.
- Early termination: if BlueHarbor cancels before month 3, credit is revocable and subject to clawback.

Why approve: strategic pilot with cross-sell potential (platform + model ops), fast ramp expected in Q3. The credit improves close probability; the quarterly invoicing reduces BlueHarbor's AP friction and aligns with their budgetary windows.

Attachments: MA-deal-terms-summary.xlsx, BlueHarbor_MA_Pricing_v3.pdf

Appreciate quick take — customer is asking to close before year-end.

Aisha
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T14:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: BlueHarbor one-time 10% onboarding credit + quarterly invoicing

Aisha / team — after reviewing the packet and revenue impact, I approve a conditional concession with the following firm conditions: 

1) One-time onboarding credit capped at 8% (not 10%) of pilot ACV, applied to the first invoice only. For the estimated $180k pilot this is $14,400.
2) Quarterly invoicing (three invoices) approved but each invoice must include the milestone acceptance clause and a PO reference.
3) Contract must be fully executed and DocuSign complete by 2026-12-31 and a signed amendment added to the master agreement that documents credit/clawback terms.
4) Payment SLA: Net-30 from invoice date. If any invoice misses payment by >15 days, the remaining credit is forfeited and we reserve the right to revert to monthly invoicing.

Karthik — please prepare the approval memo I can sign. Jonas — please confirm legal is comfortable with the clawback wording (I suggest a short addendum).

If customer accepts these terms, Sales can proceed to DocuSign.

Marissa
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

Hi Jill / Evan,

Great news — finance has granted a conditional concession. Summary of approved terms: 

• One-time onboarding credit: 8% applied to invoice #1 (capped at $14,400 based on estimated ACV).
• Quarterly invoicing: Pilot will be invoiced in three installments (1/15/27, 4/15/27, 7/15/27) with milestone acceptance required per SOW.
• Contract/Amendment: must be fully executed via DocuSign by 2026-12-31. Credit is void if contract is not executed by that date.
• Payment terms: Net-30 from invoice date. Late payment >15 days triggers credit forfeiture and right to revert to monthly invoicing.

I've attached an amendment template and the approval memo (for your records). If you confirm acceptance I'll send DocuSign.

Thanks — excited to get the pilot started.

Best,
Aisha
